phases.name: MVP — deployable vertical slice
phases.goal: A public-ready dashboard with live ISS propagation, visible-pass prediction, upcoming launches, mobile resilience, and portfolio-grade presentation.

objectives.title: Bootstrap reproducible toolchain and baseline repository
objectives.prompt: Install dependencies, generate and commit the npm lockfile, validate the starter scaffold, and make the local/CI toolchain deterministic without changing product scope.
acceptance: Node 22 and npm 10 constraints are documented
package-lock.json is generated by npm and committed
lint, typecheck, unit-test and build commands are wired
doctor reports required and optional tooling clearly
no user-specific secrets or identifiers are committed
objectives.notes: next build and next dev write different contents into next-env.d.ts (.next/types vs .next/dev/types), so a dev run leaves it modified. Regenerate or check it out after running the dev server; a later objective that owns root dotfiles should decide whether to gitignore it instead.

objectives.title: Harden resilient public-data gateways
objectives.prompt: Complete typed server-side proxies for TLE groups, Launch Library, Open Notify, and optional APOD with explicit caching, timeout, validation, last-good behavior, and repository ISS fallback. Add fetch-mocked route/parser tests.
acceptance: CelesTrak routes revalidate every 6 hours and never require client upstream access
launches revalidate every 30 minutes and normalize the next 10 records
Open Notify HTTP is proxied server-side
ISS returns repository fallback after upstream and memory cache failure
each API exposes intentional live/stale/fallback/error state
malformed upstream data cannot crash the page
objectives.notes: vitest.config.ts added to allowedPaths: its include glob was lib/**/*.test.ts only, so the fetch-mocked route tests this objective requires could not run from app/api/**.

objectives.title: Verify ISS propagation and 90-minute ground track with TDD
objectives.prompt: Harden the satellite.js wrapper so a cached TLE yields physically plausible live ISS telemetry at 1Hz, reusable Sun state, and separate −45/+45 minute ground-track segments with antimeridian protection. Use deterministic TDD fixtures.
acceptance: invalid TLE and failed propagation produce typed recoverable errors
telemetry includes lat/lng/altitude/speed/ECI and UTC timestamp
ground track covers 45 minutes past and future
no segment contains a longitude jump over 180 degrees
unit tests cover physical bounds, normalization, failure and track splitting
client hook propagates without location API polling
objectives.prTitle: feat: add deterministic ISS propagation and ground track

objectives.title: Deliver cinematic 3D live ISS globe
objectives.prompt: Turn the scaffold into the portfolio wow moment: night Earth, star field, atmosphere, smoothly moving ISS marker, past/future path styling, launch labels, cinematic intro, responsive HUD, skeleton/fade behavior and accessible interaction. Keep react-globe.gl client-only.
acceptance: globe is the dominant first-viewport element
react-globe.gl is dynamically imported with SSR disabled
ISS marker visually interpolates between 1Hz updates
past and future ground tracks are visually distinct and future is dashed
clicking ISS reaches telemetry and launch pads can focus the globe
reduced-motion and 375px viewport are supported
no horizontal overflow or hydration error
objectives.prTitle: feat: create cinematic live ISS globe

objectives.title: Implement 72-hour visible ISS pass prediction
objectives.prompt: Complete deterministic observer pass prediction for the next 72 hours, browser geolocation with embedded city fallback, civil twilight plus satellite illumination plus elevation gates, and concise cards. Add accuracy and performance tests plus a manual comparison protocol.
acceptance: geolocation success uses browser coordinates and denial falls back without breaking UI
Türkiye's 81 provinces and major world cities are searchable offline
passes are sorted and bounded to 72 hours
visibility requires sunlight, Sun altitude ≤−6°, and max elevation ≥10°
cards show time, duration, approach direction, max elevation and quality
manual Heavens-Above comparison procedure is documented without fabricated results
calculation remains responsive on target mobile viewport
objectives.prTitle: feat: predict visible ISS passes by location

objectives.title: Complete live launch and crew mission-control panels
objectives.prompt: Polish the top bar, crew badge, nearest-launch hero, five-launch manifest, absolute-time countdowns, and pad-to-globe interaction. Ensure stale/offline feeds degrade gracefully and do not shift the layout.
acceptance: top bar shows UTC, local time and current crew count when available
nearest launch has a Date.now-based live countdown
five upcoming launches show mission/provider/pad context
launch pad action focuses the globe when coordinates exist
loading/stale/error states preserve the panel and rest of dashboard
countdown behavior is tested around zero and elapsed time
objectives.prTitle: feat: add live launch mission-control panels

objectives.title: Integrate resilience, accessibility and mobile quality gates
objectives.prompt: Exercise and harden the complete MVP at desktop and 375px. Simulate every upstream failure, add accessibility and console-error checks, verify reduced motion, fix layout shifts and ensure no panel failure can take down the page.
acceptance: all four upstream services can fail independently without page crash
375px has no horizontal overflow and panels remain usable
keyboard navigation and visible focus cover interactive controls
prefers-reduced-motion is respected
no uncaught page errors or hydration warnings in E2E
skeleton/stale/empty/error states have stable dimensions
objectives.prTitle: test: harden MVP resilience and mobile accessibility
objectives.notes: e2e/home.spec.ts only asserts server-rendered headings and body.scrollWidth, so a green mobile-smoke job proves nothing about hydration or client behavior. Strengthen the mobile gate here with assertions that require the client bundle (globe mount, panel data states, console-error budget).

objectives.title: Ship portfolio-ready MVP and deployment evidence
objectives.prompt: Finalize CI, Vercel readiness, README story, architecture diagram, screenshots/GIF placeholders, API attribution, manual pass-validation record, release checklist and public demo instructions. Deploy only when Vercel ownership is available; never invent a URL or metrics.
acceptance: CI enforces lint, typecheck, unit tests, coverage, build and mobile smoke
README explains client-side propagation, resilience and agent/TDD workflow
architecture and data-flow diagrams render in GitHub
deployment instructions require no private runtime API key
real screenshots and verification evidence are linked when available
Phase 1 Definition of Done is mapped criterion by criterion

phases.name: Differentiators
phases.goal: Add Starlink scale, simulated time, terminator/shadow and APOD after the MVP is merged.

objectives.title: Add performant Starlink worker layer
objectives.prompt: Add an opt-in deterministic sample of at most 800 Starlink satellites, propagate at 1Hz in a Web Worker, batch results and render with pointsData.
acceptance: toggle defaults off
at most 800 points
worker imports satellite.js
main thread remains responsive
malformed satellites are skipped
objectives.prTitle: feat: visualize Starlink with worker propagation
objectives.notes: satellite.js is pinned to 6.0.2 on purpose: 7.x re-exports a WASM API whose runtimes import node:module and node:worker_threads, which Turbopack cannot bundle for a browser or worker target and which makes next build deadlock with no error. Keep the pin (dependabot ignores 7.x); 6.0.2 propagates 800 satellites in ~5ms per tick, so the v7 WASM BulkPropagator is not needed here.

objectives.title: Add ±90-minute simulated time control
objectives.prompt: Introduce one canonical simulated timestamp, ±90-minute slider/buttons and return-to-now behavior for ISS, tracks and Starlink.
acceptance: one canonical time source
range limited to ±90 minutes
now state updates live
worker and ISS agree on timestamp
controls accessible

objectives.title: Add terminator, sunlight detail and APOD
objectives.prompt: Render a day/night terminator, expose ISS sunlight/shadow explanation and add a resilient APOD card below the core dashboard.
acceptance: terminator follows simulated time
sun state is explainable
APOD is lazy and optional
APOD failure cannot affect MVP
mobile layout remains compact
objectives.prTitle: feat: add orbital light context and APOD

phases.name: Showcase polish
phases.goal: Optimize first impression, sharing, Lighthouse and portfolio evidence.

objectives.title: Add cinematic sharing polish
objectives.prompt: Polish intro motion and add shareable lat/lng query parameters with robust parsing.
acceptance: cinematic intro respects reduced motion
query coordinates are validated
shared links restore observer
invalid params fall back safely

objectives.title: Reach measured performance and accessibility targets
objectives.prompt: Measure and improve production Lighthouse, bundle cost, 3D loading and accessibility. Record real reports only.
acceptance: performance target measured against production build
accessibility findings resolved
3D is lazy and stable
reports committed or linked
no invented score

objectives.title: Publish final portfolio release
objectives.prompt: Create the final release narrative, real screenshots/GIF, architecture rationale, validation evidence and demo links.
acceptance: README first screen shows real product
demo URL is verified
release notes map engineering decisions
screenshots are current
repository history remains clean
